description: Shares of Shopify dropped more than 5% as investor concerns about long-term growth of the company overshadowed the company's outlook for the current quarter, per Bloomberg.

title: CertiK发布2024年第三季度安全报告，网络钓鱼和私钥泄露成主要损失源
description: CertiK's Q3 2024 security report reveals $753 million in losses, with phishing and private key leaks being the primary causes. The report highlights the growing scale of attacks and the need for stricter security measures in the Web3.0 ecosystem.

title: 4 Reasons XRP Can Go Parabolic in 2025
description: The article discusses four reasons why XRP could see a significant price increase in 2025, including a more crypto-friendly regulatory environment under the Trump administration, the potential launch of XRP exchange-traded funds, the resolution of the SEC lawsuit against Ripple, and XRP's underperformance compared to other cryptocurrencies.

title: Bitwise nennt XRP ETP um – Ripple investiert in das Produkt
description: Bitwise Asset Management has renamed its European XRP product (GXRP) as part of a broader rebranding of its European product portfolio. Ripple, a leading provider of digital asset infrastructure, has announced that it will invest in the Bitwise Physical XRP ETP (formerly ETC Group Physical XRP).

title: Bitwise rinomina l'ETP XRP, Ripple conferma la sua intenzione di investire nel prodotto
description: Bitwise Asset Management has rebranded its European ETP product range, including renaming its physical XRP ETP to 'Bitwise Physical XRP ETP'. Ripple, the digital asset infrastructure provider, has announced an investment in the rebranded ETP. The move is part of Bitwise's strategy to expand its presence in Europe.

title: Bitwise Rebrands XRP ETP; Ripple To Invest in Product
description: Bitwise Asset Management is rebranding its European XRP exchange-traded product (ETP) and renaming it the Bitwise Physical XRP ETP. Ripple, a leading provider of digital asset infrastructure, has announced that it will invest in the product.
